entries.name: Lord of the Mountain
entries.note: Appears on Satori Mountain only on some nights (waxing crescent moon; the mountain glows). Gone after about a day, or if Link enters a shrine or reloads.

entries.name: Patricia
entries.note: Lives in the Palace Courtyard inside Gerudo Town, which only admits women; Link must first get in via the 'Forbidden City Entry' quest.

entries.name: Blupee
entries.note: Skittish: flees and vanishes in a flash of light once it notices Link, so approach with stealth. Several gather on Satori Mountain when the Lord of the Mountain appears.

entries.name: Sky Octorok
entries.note: Master Mode only. Hold up floating platforms; one arrow downs them. They drop no materials.

entries.name: Silver Bokoblin
entries.note: Only appears once enemy scaling (World Level) has upgraded enemies far enough; not present early in a playthrough.

entries.name: Golden Bokoblin
entries.note: Master Mode only; appears once enemy scaling reaches its final tier. Fallback: Symin's 500-rupee Elite Enemy Picture after Dark Beast Ganon (Master Mode).

entries.name: Silver Moblin
entries.note: Only appears once enemy scaling (World Level) has upgraded enemies far enough; not present early in a playthrough.

entries.name: Golden Moblin
entries.note: Master Mode only; appears once enemy scaling reaches its final tier. Fallback: Symin's 500-rupee Elite Enemy Picture after Dark Beast Ganon (Master Mode).

entries.name: Silver Lizalfos
entries.note: Only appears once enemy scaling (World Level) has upgraded enemies far enough; not present early in a playthrough.

entries.name: Golden Lizalfos
entries.note: Master Mode only; appears once enemy scaling reaches its final tier. Fallback: Symin's 500-rupee Elite Enemy Picture after Dark Beast Ganon (Master Mode).

entries.name: Silver Lynel
entries.note: Only appears once enemy scaling (World Level) has upgraded enemies far enough; not present early in a playthrough.

entries.name: Golden Lynel
entries.note: Master Mode only; appears once enemy scaling reaches its final tier. Fallback: Symin's 500-rupee Elite Enemy Picture after Dark Beast Ganon (Master Mode).

entries.name: Master Kohga
entries.note: Fought only in the one boss battle at the Yiga Clan Hideout (Vah Naboris quest); he falls into the chasm. Fallback: Elite Enemy Picture after Dark Beast Ganon.

entries.name: Monk Maz Koshia
entries.note: Champions' Ballad: fought at the end of the Final Trial under the Shrine of Resurrection. Afterwards he can be challenged again from his pedestal.

entries.name: Igneo Talus Titan
entries.note: Champions' Ballad: fought at the north shore of Lake Darman during 'EX Champion Daruk's Song'.

entries.name: Molduking
entries.note: Champions' Ballad: appears in the East Barrens for 'EX Champion Urbosa's Song'; once defeated it returns after every Blood Moon.

entries.name: Cursed Bokoblin
entries.note: Only spawned by Malice eyes inside the four Divine Beasts and Hyrule Castle; never in the open world.

entries.name: Cursed Moblin
entries.note: Only spawned by Malice eyes inside the four Divine Beasts and Hyrule Castle; never in the open world.

entries.name: Cursed Lizalfos
entries.note: Only spawned by Malice eyes inside the four Divine Beasts and Hyrule Castle; never in the open world.

entries.name: Thunderblight Ganon
entries.note: Fought in its Divine Beast, or in Hyrule Castle if that Beast is still unfreed. The Champions' Ballad DLC adds repeatable rematches in the Illusory Realm.

entries.name: Fireblight Ganon
entries.note: Fought in its Divine Beast, or in Hyrule Castle if that Beast is still unfreed. The Champions' Ballad DLC adds repeatable rematches in the Illusory Realm.

entries.name: Waterblight Ganon
entries.note: Fought in its Divine Beast, or in Hyrule Castle if that Beast is still unfreed. The Champions' Ballad DLC adds repeatable rematches in the Illusory Realm.

entries.name: Windblight Ganon
entries.note: Fought in its Divine Beast, or in Hyrule Castle if that Beast is still unfreed. The Champions' Ballad DLC adds repeatable rematches in the Illusory Realm.

entries.name: Calamity Ganon
entries.note: Final boss in Hyrule Castle's Sanctum. After the credits the save reloads just before the final battle, so it can be fought and photographed again.

entries.name: Dark Beast Ganon
entries.note: Fought in Hyrule Field right after Calamity Ganon. Beating the game reloads the save before the final battle, so it can be refought.

entries.name: Sunshroom
entries.note: Symin never sells this picture: photographing a Sunshroom is step one of 'Sunshroom Sensing'. Grows near trees in Eldin Canyon and Gerudo Highlands.

entries.name: Master Sword
entries.note: Rests on its pedestal in Korok Forest; Link needs 13 Hearts to draw it.

entries.name: Spring-Loaded Hammer
entries.note: Sold by Kilton for 199 mon, only after at least one Divine Beast has been freed.

entries.name: Demon Carver
entries.note: Only carried by Yiga Footsoldiers that ambush Link after Master Kohga is defeated.

entries.name: One-Hit Obliterator
entries.note: Champions' Ballad: taken from the Shrine of Resurrection; usable only on the Great Plateau during that trial, then it stays on its pedestal.

entries.name: Bow of Light
entries.note: Only held during the Dark Beast Ganon fight, where Zelda gives it to Link; it is not kept afterwards. Symin also sells its Weapon Picture.

entries.name: Hylian Shield
entries.note: In a chest in Hyrule Castle's Lockup guarded by a Stalnox. Once found, Granté in Tarrey Town resells it for 3,000 rupees if Link has none.
